The vendor directly providing the software product **Checkr** at **checkr.com** is **Checkr, Inc.**

### Provider Evidence
According to the official **Checkr Legal Terms of Service**:
> *"These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) contain the terms and conditions that govern your access to and use of the services provided by Checkr, Inc. (“Checkr”), including those available on Checkr's website (the “Site”) and other websites offered by Checkr, its affiliates and partners, including but not limited to: obtaining, delivering, and managing background reports and related documentation..."*

Similarly, the **Checkr Privacy Policy** affirms:
> *"At Checkr, Inc. (“Checkr,” “us,” “we,” or “our”), we know that you care about what happens to your information... This Policy applies to https://www.checkr.com and https://www.truework.com/..."*
